verdict.rationale: Square's access is scope-controlled through OAuth with per-permission scopes, and the recommended remote MCP server for AI tools uses OAuth login so you can "authorize only the scopes your application needs" with no manual token handling. The local MCP server also offers a DISALLOW_WRITES read-only restriction, giving an extra least-privilege control for agents. Missing for 10: the specific scope catalog, documentation on revoking or expiring agent tokens, evidence on whether personal access tokens can be scoped, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
